premises.text: Diabetes care tools fail because manual logging is tedious, hardware/software are incompatible, and no platform connects patients to their support network
premises.evidence_span: proper care for diabetes is inadequate and in many countries broken due to the following usability and technical problems

premises.text: A smart audio-jack cable connects most existing glucometers to smart devices without buying new meters
premises.evidence_span: this smart cable is compatible with majority of the glucometers in the market

premises.text: App color-codes readings, tags context/meds, graphs data, and can share with doctors
premises.evidence_span: the app color codes some of the readings purple or orange if certain numbers are out of range

premises.text: Partner function lets remote family view stats, send encouragement, and get alerts if sync/tests or numbers go wrong
premises.evidence_span: I from Taiwan can use any one of my smart devices and view her stats

premises.text: Patient-centric platform enables third-party interactions such as insurers, pharmacies, rewards, and future API services
premises.evidence_span: HealthiSync also enables a patient-centric platform. enabling new forms of interaction with third parties to the patient

domains.name: legacy glucometer smart cable and app

value.text: People regain control of diabetes by aggregating glucose data and connecting support networks
value.evidence_span: Health to Sync aggregates glucose data, ultimately giving control back to you

causal_links.evidence_span: taking legacy devices, bringing them to the digital age, and making them smarter
data availability to the support network

notes: Three enumerated diabetes tool failures folded as one problem set (§4.1.6). Cable + tagging/graphing app folded as product cascade; partner alerts kept as distinct care-network module. Future insurer/pharmacy/API as platform extension premise. Indiegogo ask excluded. Four domains.
